doctrine: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — The 13 Core Invariants are the explicit constitutional law of the arif-fazil.com federation. Every page, every agent, every coder, every build, every receipt must satisfy these.
tenancy: ATLAS-1.1 supersedes ATLAS-1.0 by adding the 13 invariants + unknowns-as-objects pattern. Existing canon unchanged; new files added.

prime_invariant.statement: An agentic site is not a website. It is a public execution surface for human meaning, machine reading, and future agent behavior. Every mutation is not just design. It is reality editing.
prime_invariant.enforcement: F1 AMANAH + F9 ANTIHANTU + F11 AUDITABILITY

the_one_law: No page may define its own identity, navigation, route, color, or proof status. It must inherit from Atlas.

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: ATLAS before action
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: Every agent action begins with reading atlas.json. The Atlas is the supreme map. No mutation without consulting it.
checks: agent reads atlas.json before any edit

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: Canon before code
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: Site code is generated from canon, not written from scratch. Canon defines; code reflects.
checks: canon JSON consumed by build pipeline

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: SOT before rendered page
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: Never edit the rendered surface if a canonical source exists upstream. SOT → generator → page. Never page → hand patch → drift.
checks: page element traceable to a canon file
no in-place HTML edit when canon exists

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: Shared shell before subpage freedom
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: Every page inherits the universal frame: HeadCanon · TrinityNav · PageHero · MainContent · Proof/Status · RelatedRoutes · CanonFooter. No page gets to invent its own body.
checks: navigation.json universal_frame applied to every page

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: Tokens before local CSS
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: The page may declare data-ring and data-plane. It may not declare random colors. Agent must use tokens.css / components.css / approved classes. Not improvisation.
checks: no hard-coded colors in compiled CSS (G8)

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: Navigation before content
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: Every page must answer: Where am I? What is this page for? Where can I go next? What is the proof route? No page-specific navigation copies.
checks: G7 navigation present on every page

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: Static evidence before SPA fallback
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: For /canon/*, /999/*, .well-known/*, llms.txt, page.json, sitemap.xml — static evidence must not be swallowed by SPA fallback. Evidence routes before app routes.
checks: static paths return real content not SPA shell

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: Diff before mutation
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: Agent must produce a diff proposal before any mutation: What will change? Why? Affected routes? Affected canon? Affected generated files? Rollback path?

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: Verification before SEAL
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: No agentic site change is complete until: build passes, routes pass, canon routes serve actual files, tokens loaded, nav present, ring/plane declared, visual diff checked, machine surfaces valid, receipt emitted.

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: Unknowns declared, not hidden
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: Never leave unknowns as vibes. Use the unknowns-as-objects pattern: each unknown has id, question, risk, test, owner, verdict. Unknowns are not shame. Unknowns are control points.

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: Human owns meaning
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: The human (sovereign) decides: purpose, authority, tone, risk, truth boundary, release acceptance. Agent does not invent meaning. Agent surfaces technical consequence and risk.
checks: sovereign has final veto on every change
agent does not over-explain obvious doctrine

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: Agent owns operational clarity
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: Agent surfaces: technical consequence, hidden dependency, route conflict, cache issue, static/dynamic mismatch, unknown state, drift risk. ARIF owns meaning; agent owns operational clarity.

the_thirteen_core_invariants.name: No automation without reversibility
the_thirteen_core_invariants.statement: Every mutation has a git revert path. Bots do not push to main. No magic cron jobs. No hidden state. No irreversible side effects without sovereign ack.
checks: git revert path exists for every change
all cron jobs in federation registry

human_agent_contract.the_short_doctrine: Agentic site forging is not web design. It is governed mutation of a public truth surface. If the agent does not know the Atlas, it is blind. If the human does not know the risk, authority is fake. If unknowns are not declared, automation becomes BANGANG.
human_agent_contract.the_final_verdict: ARIF decides meaning. ATLAS defines structure. Agent mutates only inside declared boundaries. Verification turns change into truth.

the_atlas_responds.agentic_site_is: a public execution surface for human meaning, machine reading, and future agent behavior
the_atlas_responds.the_agent_should_want: preserve truth, alignment, reversibility, human authority

operator_workflow: ATLAS before action — read atlas.json, identify affected routes/components/tokens
Canon before code — verify code is generated from canon, not improvised
SOT before rendered page — edit SOT, not rendered HTML
Shared shell before subpage freedom — apply universal_frame
Tokens before local CSS — use tokens.css, no random colors
Navigation before content — inherit nav, no page-specific copies
Static evidence before SPA fallback — ensure /canon/* /999/* .well-known/* serve real content
Diff before mutation — show what will change, why, affected files, rollback
Verification before SEAL — 17 gates pass, VAULT999 receipt sealed
Unknowns declared, not hidden — every unknown has id, question, risk, test, owner, verdict
Human owns meaning — sovereign has final veto on every change
Agent owns operational clarity — surface technical consequence, hidden deps, drift risk
No automation without reversibility — every change has git revert path

maintenance.invariants.json: Updated when a new invariant is ratified or an existing one is refined. Owner: sovereign (F13).
maintenance.ATLAS version bump: Major (1.x → 2.x) when primitives change. Minor (1.0 → 1.1) when new files are added. Bug-fix (1.1.0 → 1.1.1) when invariants are tightened.
maintenance.back_compatibility: ATLAS is additive. Existing canon refs continue to work. New files are referenced from atlas.json.

tenant_contract.signature: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — 13 invariants. One Atlas. Zero hidden drift.
